headline: Indian stock markets extend gains for third day led by foreign fund inflows and lower crude prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows (FII inflows) bolstered market sentiment across trading sessions.
Lower crude oil prices provided support to equities and extended market gains.
Banking, realty, financial, and auto stocks led gains across major benchmark indices.
October retail inflation surge raised concerns over potential interest rate hikes and housing demand.
whatHappening: Sensex ended above 81,900 as markets extended gains for the third consecutive day.
Nifty held above the 25,250 mark during trading.
Gabriel India hit a 20% upper circuit on heavy trading volumes.
Gold prices dropped to their lowest level in over a year.
summary: Indian equity benchmarks extended gains for a third straight session supported by strong FII inflows and lower crude oil prices. Banking, realty, and auto stocks led the market rally, pushing the Sensex above 81,900. Individual stock action saw Gabriel India hit a 20% upper circuit and Roto Pumps jump 14%.
